title: AutoPickupMod
description: Automatically collects mined blocks and mob drops directly into your inventory. Lightweight, bug-free, and features a smart combat assist!
body:
AutoPickup is a lightweight and highly efficient Quality of Life (QoL) mod designed to bring the classic server-side auto-pickup plugin experience directly to your Forge worlds. Say goodbye to chasing items around or losing your hard-earned loot to lava!

Core Features:

Instant Block Collection: Mined blocks and ores are instantly placed into your inventory. The mod precisely tracks the exact millisecond of the block break, making it safe and seamlessly compatible with mass-mining mods like FTB Ultimine.

Smart Combat Assist System: Did you hit a mob, but it died to fire, lava, or fall damage a few seconds later? No problem! The mod features a built-in 5-second "assist memory." If you recently damaged an entity before it dies, the loot still goes straight into your pockets.

Zero Ghost Items: Built using Forge's native item handlers. If your inventory happens to be full, the excess items won't disappear into the void; they will drop safely at your feet.

Perfect for fast-paced RPG modpacks, chaotic boss fights, or just a relaxing mining session. Just drop it into your mods folder and never lose a drop again!
